title: catskillsresearch/scott1980
summary: A Lean 4 / mathlib formalization of Dana Scott's 1980 Oxford lectures, published May 1981 as PRG-19 Lectures on a Mathematical Theory of Computation. The principal sourced Palomar result is the first sentence of Theorem 8.8: the neighbourhood system U over [0,1) ⊆ ℚ is universal, in the sense that every countable neighbourhood system D embeds as a subdomain (D ⊴ U). Comparator also selects two new formal corollaries: P4_embeds for Scott's Example 1.5 and Ssys_embeds for Exercise 7.22. Scott defines those systems but does not separately state the embeddings.
